usageNote: 口语短语！说朋友/家人关系超铁、患难与共时用，温暖又接地气，不是字面上的'在那里'哦！

examples.en: No matter what happens, they are there for each other.
examples.zh: 无论发生什么，他们都互相支持。

examples.en: They've been through so much together — they are always there for each other.
examples.zh: 他们一起经历了那么多，始终相互扶持。
